name: The Seer at Tser Pool
summary: The Vistani say an old seer at Tser Pool reads the Tarokka for strangers, and that she has been expecting us.

stages.journal: At the Vistani camp by Tser Pool, Stanimir told us Madam Eva has been expecting us in the great tent. She reads the Tarokka for strangers, at a price.
objectives: Visit Madam Eva in her tent

stages.journal: We told Madam Eva we would not hear her reading. She shrugged and said the cards are patient. She will be in her tent if we change our minds.
objectives: Return to Madam Eva's tent when you are ready

stages.journal: Madam Eva read the Tarokka for us: where three lost treasures lie, who will stand with us, and where the devil will be waiting. Each card has its own place in this journal.
